title: Adopt Asynchronous Event Sourcing via Kafka for Payment Processing
summary: Migrate all payment authorization, order confirmation, and ledger recording from synchronous REST calls to Kafka event streams to eliminate cascading outages and buffer sudden traffic spikes.
alternatives: 1. Synchronous REST with exponential backoff & circuit breakers (rejected due to memory pool bloat). 2. RabbitMQ message broker (rejected due to lack of replayability and partitioning scalability).
